sources_used: instagram/official chain pages where linked from shard

findings.name: Antonio's Boliche - Shopping Catuaí Cascavel
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv lists only Cruis'n Blast; Dead Heat (2P); Jurassic Park Arcade (2015). Bowling alley (Antonio's Boliche) at Shopping Catuaí Cascavel. No music/rhythm cabs on record; no independent inventory found.
findings.note: Bowling + few racing/shooter cabs. Absence of rhythm on thin ZIv list is not positive proof of none. No Pump/DDR hits for this branch.

findings.name: Arcademia
findings.evidence_quote: Arcademia Fliperama Curitiba is a fighting-game specialty hall: Street Fighter Alpha 3 / Super Street Fighter 2X tournaments, Marvel vs Capcom 2, Final Fight, X-Men vs Street Fighter. ZIv cab note: Street Fighter Alpha 3 only.
findings.note: Positive profile as tournament fighter fliperama; no rhythm machines advertised in socials or ZIv. Not a music-game venue.

findings.name: Fair Play DIversões - Maxi Shopping
findings.evidence_quote: Visitor inventory (2025): racing (Cruis'n Blast, Dead Heat, Fast & Furious 2022, Mario Kart GP DX, Super Bikes 2/3, Ultra Moto VR), shooters, Lane Master XTREME, To Tha Net, cranes. Description: mostly racing and cranes; no music games listed.
findings.note: Strong partial inventory with zero rhythm titles, but ZIv is not exhaustive. No external Pump/DDR confirmation. Leave unknown rather than invent confirmed_none.

findings.name: Game Station - Caruaru Shopping

findings.note: Sister Game Station sites sometimes carry Guitar Hero Arcade or PIU; this branch inventory (2023) has none. Inventory may be incomplete; no newer source found.

findings.name: Game Station - North Shopping Fortaleza
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International) Location: Entrance, left side, close to the pool tables. Price R$5.00. Condition: Not Working (as of visit log).
findings.note: Guitar Hero Arcade is a coin-op music game not in the bemani/slug set; mapped to other. Status was Not Working in 2023; presence still counts as has_games. No PIU/DDR/taiko listed.

findings.name: Game Station - Shopping Parangaba
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International) Location: Next to the pool table. Price R$5.00. Condition: Great.
findings.note: Working Guitar Hero Arcade on detailed 2023 inventory. Slug: other. No Pump/DDR/taiko on that list.

findings.name: Game Station @ Plaza Shopping
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv page has address, hours, and website (gamestation.com.br/shopping-plaza.php) but Games: No games at this location. No visitor machine list.
findings.note: Empty ZIv is silence, not confirmed_none. Chain elsewhere has GHA/PIU/taiko at some stores; no specific Recife Plaza evidence found.

findings.name: Game Station Franca SP
findings.evidence_quote: Includes the following notable machines: ... Pump It Up!; ... Wadaiko Master (Brazilian localization of Taiko no Tatsujin); Guitar Hero the Arcade; House of the Dead 4; ...
findings.note: ZIv information block (2024) explicitly names Pump It Up, Wadaiko Master (= taiko), and Guitar Hero Arcade (= other). Games table empty so counts not stated; presence only. Unverified against 2025-2026 visit.

findings.name: Login House eXP
findings.evidence_quote: O maior hub gamer e tech da américa latina. Setup: PS5 & Lanhouse (10 PCs), streaming/conteúdo, gastronomia e mixologia, eventos e watch parties. No coin-op arcade or music cabinets described.
findings.note: PC lanhouse + console bar at Vila Madalena, not a music-game arcade. Positive product description excludes coin-op rhythm cabs.

findings.name: Magic Games - Shopping Catuaí Londrina
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Dance Central 3 (International). Condition: Moderate. Medium-sized arcade with 25+ machines from Magic Games franchise.
findings.note: Dance Central 3 is a Kinect-style dance/music title; slug other (not ddr/dance_around). No bemani/PIU listed.

findings.name: Magic Games Tietê Plaza Shopping
findings.evidence_quote: Magic Games store page for Tietê Plaza (Av. Raimundo Pereira de Magalhães, 1465). ZIv notes: Daytona USA (2P); Indy 500; Super Bikes 3 only. Mall posts mention Just Dance event programming separately, not permanent cabs.
findings.note: Thin racing-only ZIv list. Just Dance mentions appear event-based, not a fixed music cab. Cannot confirm has_games or confirmed_none.

findings.name: Neo Geo Arcade Shopping Ibirapuera

findings.note: Neo Geo Family is an indoor amusement-park chain (redemption/rides). No PIU/DDR evidence for Ibirapuera branch. Incomplete inventory => unknown.

findings.name: Pizza Americana

findings.note: Two classic cabs only on ZIv. No rhythm evidence; not enough for confirmed_none.

findings.name: Planet Park - RioMar Kennedy

findings.note: Family mall arcade list with no music cabs, but list may be incomplete. No external rhythm hits.

findings.name: Play Show Games - Rio das Ostras
findings.evidence_quote: PlayShow Games Rio das Ostras markets boliche, airsoft, kids games, birthday parties. Instagram @playshow_games: bowling and general diversões; no Pump/DDR/music-cab listings found.
findings.note: Bowling/entertainment complex. ZIv empty of cabs. No positive music evidence and no exhaustive inventory.

findings.name: PlayLand
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Percussion Kids (International) Comment: 小鼓王. Price R$5.50. Condition: Bad. Photo on ZIv labeled Percussion Kid 小鼓王 (updated 2025-03-24).
findings.note: Percussion Kids is a children's drum rhythm cab; mapped to other. Large inventory otherwise redemption/racing/shooters; no PIU/DDR/taiko.

findings.name: Playcenter Family- Shopping Aricanduva
findings.evidence_quote: Large 2025 visitor inventory (racing, rail shooters, redemption, skeeball, Lane Master). No music/rhythm titles among dozens of logged machines.
findings.note: Very full non-music floor list but still not a sworn complete census. Treat as unknown.

findings.name: 1UP Games
findings.evidence_quote: Information: Arcade no longer has machines, in storage according to owner/guy at counter. Updated 2024-01-22. Historical MAACA 2019 list at 105 King St E included DDR 3rd Mix; ZIv photos include ITG cab.
findings.note: Public coin-op floor retired; machines in storage. Address in shard (777 King W) differs from older 105 King E listing. Historical DDR/ITG not currently playable. If store still sells games, arcade section is effectively closed.

findings.name: Amusements Jolin
findings.evidence_quote: Votre repère habituel d'arcade « Les amusements Jolin », dorénavant sous l'appellation « La Zone Amusements », change d'adresse... 1027 Bd Saint-Joseph. Featured games: Black Hole, Jurassic World, Plinko, Super Bikes 3, Mario Kart, pinball, redemption - no ITG/dance listed. ZIv previously: ITG2 OpenITG dedicab at 471 Rue Lindsay; temporarily closed until Sept 2023 comment about reopening bigger space.
findings.note: Old Amusements Jolin address is retired. Successor La Zone Amusements is a different sid/address; do not attach ITG to this sid without re-confirming at new site. Historical ITG at old site is gone with move.

findings.name: Antigonish Arena
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Claw Machine; Krazy Bowl; Soul Edge; Stacker. Ice arena / public facility with token amusements, not a music arcade.
findings.note: Positive mix is claw/redemption/bowling + one fighter. No rhythm machines; venue type is arena lobby, not game center.

findings.name: Antisocial Pinball
findings.evidence_quote: Official site and Pinball Map/Pinside: PERMANENTLY CLOSED (reported closed as of June 2026). Was 19+ pinball lounge at 570 Bloor St W with pinball + some non-music arcade (Wangan, DoDonPachi, etc. per ZIv notes).
findings.note: Closed permanently. Even when open, ZIv list had no bemani/PIU/DDR; pinball-focused.

findings.name: Arcade Hamilton (Moodys)
findings.evidence_quote: Moody's closed Jan 2025 to rebrand as Ooey Gooey's at same 107 George St. Reddit/Instagram: a few cabinets upstairs, available mainly during shows/events. ZIv classic list: Cruis'n USA; Mario Bros; Street Fighter II; TETRIS; TMNT - no music games.
findings.note: Venue rebranded; public arcade access reduced. Historical cabs non-music. Status of remaining machines unclear; not closed entirely but not a full-time music arcade.

findings.name: Axes & Apples
findings.evidence_quote: Axes & Apples Cold Lake: axe throwing + Retro Arcades $0.25 per play. ZIv cabs: Galaga; Lethal Enforcers; Pac-Land; Stacker; Time Soldiers. Hosted Red Ant Retro classics.
findings.note: Adult axe venue with classic retro cabs only. No dance/music cabs in any source.

findings.name: BB Friday's Tap And Grill
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Golden Tee 2020. Sports bar / grill with a golf video game only.
findings.note: Single non-music bar game. Positive evidence of bar-only entertainment, not a music arcade.

findings.name: BOWLARAMA
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Claw Machine; Stacker. Bowlarama Halifax (Desmond Ave) bowling alley with token merchandisers only on ZIv.
findings.note: Bowling + claw/stacker only. Positive limited-amusement profile; no rhythm games.

findings.name: Baller's Rec Room
findings.evidence_quote: Official games page lists: Pool, Foosball, Golden Tee 2019, Mario Kart arcade, Star Wars pinball, AC/DC pinball, Skee Ball, Cruisin' Hoops, Halo. No DDR/Pump/ITG/maimai or other music rhythm titles.
findings.note: Published venue game list is positive evidence of no music rhythm cabs.

findings.name: Bar le Vox
findings.evidence_quote: Retro-gaming bar: pinball machines and arcade games, pool, foosball. ZIv list is pinball + classic video (OutRun, House of the Dead, Mortal Kombat, Ms. Pac-Man, etc.) with no DDR/Pump/ITG/bemani.
findings.note: Long classic/pinball roster; no music rhythm titles. Free-play with drink purchase per local posts.

findings.name: Beercade
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv: No games at this location. Website beercade.ca returns minimal content. Facebook BeercadeYEG exists; no public authoritative machine list found for music games.
findings.note: Barcade concept on Whyte Ave. Empty ZIv + thin web footprint. Cannot confirm open/closed or games. Leave unknown.

findings.evidence_quote: GAMES @ MARDA LOOP: Galaga, Street Fighter II, Ms. PAC-MAN, Mortal Kombat, Multicade (over 50 different classics), Lethal Weapon III Pinball & Golden Axe.
findings.note: Official branch game list has no music rhythm cabs. Retro diner arcade only.

findings.name: Bowlacade
findings.evidence_quote: Cabs: Claw Machine; Key Master. Truro NS bowling/entertainment; token merchandisers only.

findings.name: Bowlarama
findings.evidence_quote: Long ZIv redemption/sports list (Basketball, Big Bass Wheel Pro, Big Buck Hunter, Claw, Cyclone, Jurassic Park Arcade, Super Bikes, Stacker, etc.). No music/rhythm titles.
findings.note: Halifax Dentith Road bowling arcade. Extensive non-music inventory is positive that floor is redemption/sports focused.

findings.note: Pinball brewery concept. Positive pinball-only evidence.

findings.name: Capital City Arcade

findings.name: Carnival Cinemas
